name: Panoramahütte Alpspitz
kurzbeschreibung:
**Alpspitz Panorama Hut in Tirol**

Discover breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps** from the **Alpspitz Panorama Hut**, a cozy mountain refuge perched at **2,256 meters** above sea level. Just a short hike from **Finkenberg**, this alpine gem offers hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Tiroler Gröstl**, and homemade strudel, paired with local **Apfelstrudel** or a warming mug of **Tiroler Bergkäse** soup.

In summer, enjoy sun-drenched terraces with panoramic vistas, while winter transforms the hut into a snug retreat for skiers and snowboarders—just a few minutes from the **Finkenberg ski area**. Whether you're here for adventure or relaxation, the **Alpspitz Panorama Hut** promises unforgettable moments in the heart of **Tirol’s** wild beauty.

<iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=..." width="600" height="450" style="border:0;" allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy"></iframe>

**Tip:** Reach the hut via the well-marked trail from **Finkenberg** (about **1.5 hours**) or take the **Finkenbergbahn** cable car for a scenic ride. **Reservations recommended**—especially in peak season!
